relationships.subject: AM6545

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: the inflammatory mediator PGE2 produces sensitization of the noxious heat transduction channel TRPV1 and increases excitability in mouse DRG neurons

relationships.subject: CB-13
relationships.evidence_quote: CB-13 can partially attenuate PGE2-induced hyperexcitability in DRG neurons without affecting baseline membrane properties

relationships.subject: CB-13
relationships.evidence_quote: By day 7 of repeated dosing, analgesic tolerance appeared to develop to all doses of CB-13 in both male and female mice.

key_findings: CB-13 analgesia is mediated by peripheral CB1 (not CB2) and reduces PGE2-induced TRPV1 sensitization and DRG hyperexcitability
Repeated CB-13 dosing causes tolerance and CB1 dependence, suggesting central exposure
